evidence.why: Item selector and independent flag latch.

facts.rationale: Replaces guaranteed activation and unsupported default rumble lifetime with actual ordered requests and optional branches.
facts.value: Runs shared post-transition Hammer setup in order: conditionally requests color-animation entry 106, requests held-item hit activation and latches x2219_b4, then calls ftCommon_8007EBAC(fp,1,0). Item activation falls back to reset when Item.xD4C is nonpositive; feedback submission is conditional on common player and Fighter guards. It does not directly choose a motion state.

facts.rationale: Corrects hitbox-versus-rumble confusion and overlay restoration wording while preserving exact branch order and zero boundaries.
facts.value: Skips all work in LightGet. Otherwise decrements nonzero x2330.x; decrements nonzero x2330.y only in the inclusive HammerWait-through-HammerLanding interval, and on its transition to zero sets x2338.x=1, calls it_80293E34 and conditionally removes rumble ID 3 through ftCommon_8007ECD4(fp,true). It next handles primary zero, including zero on entry, by destroying the item, clearing paired audio state, sampling selected overlay ID 106, conditionally dispatching ordinary ground/air processing if still in the Hammer interval, and resetting/reconstructing overlay 106 if sampled active. Finally it decrements nonzero x2338.y. Simultaneous expiry processes head loss before destruction; no local clamp repairs negative counters.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes Fighter bookkeeping reset from physical head state and avoids assuming positive asset values or idempotent audio setup.
facts.value: Every invocation copies x6AC to x2330.x, obtains x2330.y from the held Hammer's random timer helper, clears both x2338 fields, calls pl_800403C0 only if the timer is nonzero, and increments paired audio reference x2168 through ft_800880AC. It makes no direct motion transition and does not reattach a physical head. Repeated invocation reloads counters but increments the audio reference again. Actual configured duration, probability and random bounds are not established here; zero is an inactive timer regardless of why the random helper returned it.

evidence.why: Active Hammer-state consumer associates 0x6A with the family.

facts.rationale: States the actual request contract instead of an unconditional ensure-active postcondition.
facts.value: Requests Hammer-associated color-animation entry 106 with false only when ftCo_800C0694 reports a different selected overlay ID. It ignores ftCo_800BFFD0's Boolean result, so successful installation is not guaranteed; it issues no request when 106 is already selected.

facts.rationale: Corrects collision-animation terminology and avoids blanket preservation claims.
facts.value: Selects a shared Hammer entry-policy mask from source motion: inside the inclusive HammerWait-through-HammerLanding interval it returns Ft_MF_SkipHit|Ft_MF_SkipModel|Ft_MF_SkipMatAnim|Ft_MF_SkipRumble|Ft_MF_SkipColAnim|Ft_MF_UpdateCmd|Ft_MF_Unk19, otherwise Ft_MF_None. Normal Hammer-family entries consume this mask. It selectively skips hit, model, material-animation, selected rumble and color-animation resets; Unk19 avoids clearing x2222_b2. It does not preserve all state, inspect the destination or govern the separate platform-pass path, which explicitly uses no flags.

evidence.why: Window and input gates lead to drop and ordinary Fall.

facts.rationale: Adds the verified cross-file consumer explaining the auxiliary post-damage countdown without inventing duration or original name.
facts.value: Reloads Fighter.x2338.y from p_ftCommonData->x6B8. Damage hold completion invokes it only for a Fighter still holding a Hammer. The shared lifecycle updater decrements the nonzero field outside LightGet; HammerFall consumes nonzero as one gate for dropping the Hammer and entering ordinary Fall, additionally requiring newly pressed A, held L/R and x683 >= x1C. The setter and timer expiry do not themselves change motion state.

facts.rationale: Makes exceptional-float and boundary behavior explicit without changing verified continuity policy.
facts.value: Returns cur_anim_frame unchanged when source motion satisfies the inclusive HammerWait-through-HammerLanding predicate, otherwise floating zero. There is no finite or nonnegative validation: negative frames, infinities and NaNs are forwarded on the in-range branch. The helper selects an entry parameter, not an animation-time clamp.
